cues.zh: 他領導伯克希爾能源業務多年。

cues.text: But it is tricky. Warren Buffett has not only been a very good investor, but he's also pretty charismatic.
cues.en: But it is tricky. Warren Buffett has not only been a very good investor, but he's also pretty charismatic.
cues.zh: 但這很棘手。華倫‧巴菲特不僅是一位非常優秀的投資者，而且還非常有魅力。

cues.text: That's part of the reason that so many investors have always made that trek to Omaha.
cues.en: That's part of the reason that so many investors have always made that trek to Omaha.
cues.zh: 這也是許多投資者不遠千里來到奧馬哈的部分原因。

cues.text: Despite the cost, despite the distance.
cues.en: Despite the cost, despite the distance.
cues.zh: 儘管費用昂貴，儘管距離遙遠。

cues.text: Abel will also be taking charge at a time when Buffett's hallmark strategy is being tested.
cues.en: Abel will also be taking charge at a time when Buffett's hallmark strategy is being tested.
cues.zh: 阿貝爾也將在巴菲特的標誌性策略受到考驗之際上任。

cues.text: It is tough to be a value investor when what's really lifting the stock market is high-growth companies.
cues.en: It is tough to be a value investor when what's really lifting the stock market is high-growth companies.
cues.zh: 當真正提振股市的是高成長公司時，成為價值投資者是很困難的。

cues.text: The tech companies valuation might be really high compared
cues.en: The tech companies valuation might be really high compared
cues.zh: 相比之下，科技公司的估值可能真的很高

cues.text: to sort of what the underlying assets are.
cues.en: to sort of what the underlying assets are.
cues.zh: 對標的資產進行排序。

cues.text: While Buffett has bet on technology in recent years, his misses on those opportunities will always sort of linger
cues.en: While Buffett has bet on technology in recent years, his misses on those opportunities will always sort of linger
cues.zh: 儘管巴菲特近年來一直押注於科技，但他對這些機會的錯失將永遠揮之不去

cues.text: The change in leadership also risks reviving a longstanding debate.
cues.en: The change in leadership also risks reviving a longstanding debate.
cues.zh: 領導階層的更迭也有可能重新引發一場長期存在的爭論。

cues.text: A conglomerate is not a thing that has stuck around.
cues.en: A conglomerate is not a thing that has stuck around.
cues.zh: 企業集團並不是一個長期存在的東西。

cues.text: We've seen many conglomerates such as GE fall apart in recent years and sort of be split up.
cues.en: We've seen many conglomerates such as GE fall apart in recent years and sort of be split up.
cues.zh: 近年來，我們看到許多像通用電氣這樣的企業集團分崩離析，甚至有些分裂。

cues.text: Buffett's presence at Berkshire won't be disappearing overnight.
cues.en: Buffett's presence at Berkshire won't be disappearing overnight.
cues.zh: 巴菲特在伯克希爾的存在不會在一夜之間消失。

cues.text: He'll remain as chairman and I think his influence will still be felt by the company.
cues.en: He'll remain as chairman and I think his influence will still be felt by the company.
cues.zh: 他將繼續擔任董事長，我認為公司仍然會感受到他的影響力。

cues.text: He's a major shareholder of the firm and while he is slowly divesting that stake and giving it
cues.en: He's a major shareholder of the firm and while he is slowly divesting that stake and giving it
cues.zh: 他是該公司的主要股東，同時他正在慢慢剝離該股份並給予

cues.text: to his children's foundations, I think his legacy will long be felt.
cues.en: to his children's foundations, I think his legacy will long be felt.
cues.zh: 對於他的孩子們的基金會來說，我認為他的遺產將長期被人們所感受到。

cues.text: But Abel will be taking over many of his duties, including the writing of Berkshire's annual letter to shareholders.
cues.en: But Abel will be taking over many of his duties, including the writing of Berkshire's annual letter to shareholders.
cues.zh: 但阿貝爾將接手他的許多職責，包括撰寫波克夏致股東的年度信函。

cues.text: This is a big change because Buffett fans have been poring over that letter over the years
cues.en: This is a big change because Buffett fans have been poring over that letter over the years
cues.zh: 這是一個很大的變化，因為巴菲特的粉絲多年來一直在仔細研究這封信

cues.text: because it's full of witticisms, investment advice, pearls of wisdom.
cues.en: because it's full of witticisms, investment advice, pearls of wisdom.
cues.zh: 因為它充滿了俏皮話、投資建議和智慧珍珠。

cues.text: There's also the fact that he's not going to be taking Q&A at the annual meeting next May in Omaha.
cues.en: There's also the fact that he's not going to be taking Q&A at the annual meeting next May in Omaha.

cues.text: Welcome to Berkshire Hathaway.
cues.en: Welcome to Berkshire Hathaway.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到波克夏海瑟威。

cues.text: He was talking for four to five hours every year
cues.en: He was talking for four to five hours every year
cues.zh: 他每年要講四到五個小時

cues.text: and taking questions from people that follow him all over the planet.
cues.en: and taking questions from people that follow him all over the planet.
cues.zh: 並回答世界各地關注他的人的問題。

cues.text: That is gonna be a big change because Buffett's personality isn't matched in the investment world.
cues.en: That is gonna be a big change because Buffett's personality isn't matched in the investment world.
cues.zh: 這將是一個巨大的變化，因為巴菲特的個性與投資界不符。
